title: A musical program's data: res/musicals/programs/<n>/data.json
description: Member 0 of the archive ARCID_MUSICAL_PROGRAM + n (a/1/1/2 to a/1/1/5), the program's MusicalProgramData (src/ov012/musical_program.c), which MusicalSystem_LoadProgramData loads; tools/data/musical_program_data.py packs it with the program's other members.

base_program.description: The program's number, which MusicalProgram_GetBaseProgramId gives: each built-in program has its own, 0 to 3

points.description: The points the audience has for each of the four kinds of prop (MusItemData_GetKind), which the props of a kind that the Pokémon wear share out

bonus.description: Points the program adds to the kinds at random, by fives, each time it is put on (MusicalProgram_Create)

prop_list.description: The program's list of props to give away (MusicalProgram_GetPropList)

unk07.description: Bytes 7 to 11, which musical_program.c doesn't read

performers.description: The program's performers (MusicalNpc), from which the game picks the other three entrants at random among those whose min_shots the player has reached, or the first three if fewer have

form.description: The Pokémon's form, which is also the top byte of its personality

obj_code.description: The performer's look, the low byte of the Pokémon's personality: an object code, as the player's is OBJ_CODE_HERO or OBJ_CODE_HEROINE (musical_program.c's trainerClass, MusicalEvent_GetOwnerTrainerClass)

name.description: The performer's name, the second byte of the Pokémon's personality: a message of res/text/system/btl_main_9.txt by its ID, or a number; the same line of musical_event.txt is the Pokémon's nickname

personality_byte_2.description: The third byte of the Pokémon's personality

unk06.description: Given to MusicalStageParam_CreateNpcPoke, which keeps it in the MusicalPoke's unk78

min_shots.description: The photos the player must have taken before the performer appears

props.description: The props the Pokémon wears (MusicalProgram_PutNpcOnStage), each [item, slot]

prefixItems.description: The prop, a musical item by number (MusItemData)
Where the Pokémon wears it, a MusicalPoke equip slot, 0 to 8
